objective: GATE 3D-C SoftRestaurant WRITE CONTRACT DISCOVERY, estrictamente READ ONLY. Certificar schema completo de dbo.pagosproveedores, PK/UQ/defaults/nullability, FKs reales, patrones agregados de pagos existentes sin exponer transacciones, relaciones demostrables con compras, chequespagos, gastos y polizas, y evaluar si referencia puede soportar idempotencia sin asumir unicidad. No implementar ni probar writer.

queries.name: gate3dc_pagosproveedores_columns_full
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,COLUMNPROPERTY(c.object_id,c.name,'IsComputed') AS is_computed,dc.name AS default_name,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate3dc_pagosproveedores_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.type_desc,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: gate3dc_pagosproveedores_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS constraint_name,o.type_desc,cc.definition AS check_definition FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN sys.check_constraints cc ON cc.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') AND o.type IN ('PK','UQ','C','D','F') ORDER BY o.type,o.name

queries.name: gate3dc_pagosproveedores_foreign_keys_all
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.delete_referential_action_desc,fk.update_referential_action_desc FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id INNER JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') OR fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY parent_schema,parent_table,fk.name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: gate3dc_reference_index_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') AND c.name=N'referencia' ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate3dc_existing_shape_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos,SUM(CASE WHEN foliocompra IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS foliocompra_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN fecha IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fecha_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN abono IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abono_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN referencia IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS referencia_vacia,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT foliocompra) AS compras_distintas,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia)),'')) AS referencias_distintas FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: gate3dc_reference_duplicate_aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS referencias_repetidas FROM (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia)) AS referencia_norm FROM dbo.pagosproveedores WHERE referencia IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))<>'' GROUP BY LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia)) HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d

queries.name: gate3dc_same_purchase_reference_duplicate_aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS combinaciones_repetidas FROM (SELECT foliocompra,LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia)) AS referencia_norm FROM dbo.pagosproveedores WHERE referencia IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))<>'' GROUP BY foliocompra,LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia)) HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d

queries.name: gate3dc_candidate_related_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE N'%pagosproveedores%' OR o.name LIKE N'%chequespagos%' OR o.name LIKE N'%gasto%' OR o.name LIKE N'%poliza%' OR o.name=N'compras' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: gate3dc_related_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id INNER JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'gastos') OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'gastos') ORDER BY parent_schema,parent_table,fk.name

queries.name: gate3dc_triggers_related
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_object,t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger,sm.definition FROM sys.triggers t LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON sm.object_id=t.object_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'gastos') ORDER BY parent_schema,parent_object,t.name

queries.name: gate3dc_module_links_pago_gasto_cheque_poliza
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 120 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%pagosproveedores%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%chequespagos%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%gasto%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%poliza%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%compras%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: gate3dc_expression_dependencies_related
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_object,o.type_desc,d.referenced_schema_name,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d LEFT JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=d.referencing_id WHERE d.referenced_entity_name IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'gastos') OR OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'gastos') ORDER BY referencing_schema,referencing_object,d.referenced_entity_name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider invoice payment or amount rows
Only schema metadata and aggregates for existing-data patterns
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Do not declare referencia idempotent unless uniqueness and observed duplicates support it
Do not infer relationship to cheques gastos or poliza without runtime dependency evidence
